baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated بعث root converts a received awakening into a delegated mission: a stirred collective questions reciprocally, then reproduces that movement by sending one member outward.

activation_trace.role: Stirring what was stationary supplies the initiating transition from dormancy to inquiry.
Sending and directing a delegate turns awakening into an outwardly aimed task.
Reciprocal questioning makes the awakened group a distributed inquiry rather than passive recipients.
The connection maintained between participants is the channel through which inquiry becomes coordinated action.

changed_reading.before: They wake, converse, and later send someone for food.
changed_reading.after: Their awakening is generative: being stirred creates reciprocal inquiry, and that inquiry condenses into a directed human dispatch.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: كم لبثتم / يوما أو بعض يوم / ربكم أعلم بما لبثتم
baseline_models.mechanism: Three repetitions of staying are measured first by a bounded day and then a fraction of it, but the group relocates the inaccessible total to their Lord's knowledge and proceeds with what can be acted upon.

activation_trace.role: Staying in a place supplies the duration whose scale the speakers cannot securely recover.
A bounded daylight unit supplies their first concrete but provisional measure.
Partitioning the day retracts the first estimate and exposes uncertainty within even the small unit.
Knowledge as disclosure marks the point where their estimate yields to a knower with fuller access.

changed_reading.before: The sleepers make an inaccurate estimate of elapsed time.
changed_reading.after: They perform epistemic triage: test a bounded estimate, qualify it, assign the inaccessible duration to superior knowledge, and avoid letting uncertainty block action.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: بورقكم / إلى المدينة / أزكى طعاما / برزق منه / وليتلطف / ولا يشعرن
baseline_models.mechanism: Money, city, inspection, filtered food, returned provision, delicacy, and suppressed awareness form one end-to-end acquisition protocol whose success includes both nourishment and a low perceptual signature.

activation_trace.role: Money and coin supply the portable means by which the hidden group can transact outside.
The gathering city supplies the dense social field through which the delegate must move.
The observing guardian or investigative emissary casts the buyer as a scout, not merely a consumer.
Purity and soundness make the food choice a filter for acceptable outcome, not quantity alone.
Fitness to circumstance adds operational suitability to the criterion of purity.
An apportioned benefit recasts the purchase as provision returned to the whole group.
Small, fine, hidden movement supplies the transaction's low-visibility method.
Fine awareness supplies the signal that must not arise in any outsider.

changed_reading.before: One sleeper goes into town to buy good food discreetly.
changed_reading.after: The group designs a screened provisioning chain: scout, discriminate, acquire, return, and leave no informative signal.

baseline_models.mechanism: The two occurrences of أحد define opposite sides of a narrow information aperture: one member may cross outward as representative, while no outsider may cross inward through awareness of the group.

activation_trace.role: One in counting individuates the single delegate from the collective.
Exhaustive negation closes awareness to every possible outsider.
Gentle, tactful conduct regulates the one permitted outward crossing.

changed_reading.before: They select someone and tell him not to expose them.
changed_reading.after: The wording specifies an information topology: exactly one outward representative, tactfully managed, and zero inward recognition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier purpose statement frames awakening as a comparison of rival duration counts; the later warnings against conjecturing about the unseen and the return of elapsed time to divine knowledge make the focus dialogue an enacted discipline of measuring without pretending to mastery.

activation_trace.role: Mutual questioning is the focus-level procedure through which competing estimates surface.
The stay supplies the common object being measured and finally deferred.
Two opinion-groups supply the comparison whose live traces appear in the focus dialogue.
Exhaustive numerical reckoning supplies the criterion against which the speakers' day estimate is exposed.
A duration's endpoint supplies the unavailable scale the experiment seeks to determine.
Guessing at the unseen supplies the later negative model for unsupported counting.
What is hidden from sight bounds the domain in which enumeration can claim certainty.
Doubt and oscillation supply the state that disciplined qualification should not harden into fruitless dispute.
Full disclosure of the elapsed stay is again assigned to God, confirming the focus speakers' epistemic handoff.
The same stay reappears as an object whose true duration exceeds participant access.

structural_cues: 18:12 states the awakening's purpose with which-party and better-counted syntax; 18:19 performs it through reciprocal duration estimates.
The formula God or your Lord knows best about their stay recurs in 18:19, 18:22, and 18:26.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies awakening, rival count, unsupported unseen-guessing, and repeated deference of the stay to divine knowledge; I infer that 18:19 enacts an epistemic trial whose success is calibrated limitation, while a live alternative is simple post-sleep disorientation.

changed_reading.before: The group fails to remember how long it slept.
changed_reading.after: The group enacts the stated measurement trial and succeeds ethically by exposing rival estimates, qualifying its count, and refusing to convert inaccessible duration into confident conjecture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The shared superlative-selection frame links the tested question of who is best in deed to the delegate's question of which food is purest or most fitting, turning an ordinary purchase into a small practical trial of discernment within worldly display.

activation_trace.role: A test that makes actual quality appear supplies the wider frame for discriminating among market options.
The better-quality comparison in deeds supplies the syntactic and evaluative analogue for choosing food.
Purity and sound consequence give the market comparison an ethical as well as sensory criterion.
Fitness to present conditions makes the selected food a test of situated judgment.

structural_cues: 18:7 has أيهم أحسن عملا; 18:19 has أيها أزكى طعاما, repeating an interrogative-superlative-indefinite-accusative selection frame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel ranking constructions and a world displayed as a test; I infer that market selection miniaturizes that test as practical discernment, while the live alternative is a purely mundane quality comparison.

changed_reading.before: The delegate should locate the best or cleanest meal.
changed_reading.after: The delegate's food choice is a micro-trial: discern what is genuinely sound and situationally fit inside an attractive but testing social field.

context_deltas.mechanism: The promised spreading of mercy and prepared facility takes operational form in the focus ayah as apportioned provision obtained through gentle, precise conduct; divine preparation and human logistics occupy successive links in one care process.

activation_trace.role: Opening and spreading supplies the expansion of sheltering mercy into usable possibilities.
Tender mercy supplies the source from which material care can unfold.
Preparation and making-ready supply the enabling conditions for the later mission.
Facility and benefit supply the promised usable outcome that the food mission realizes.
Apportioned provision is the concrete benefit brought back to the refuge.
Gentle tact supplies the human manner by which prepared benefit reaches the group.

structural_cues: 18:16 promises that their Lord will spread mercy and prepare a facility; 18:19 names their Lord, seeks provision, and commands gentle conduct.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies promised mercy, preparation, facility, provision, and tact; I infer a causal handoff in which human logistics mediate prepared mercy, while an alternative is that the purchase is only an independent practical response.

changed_reading.before: The group solves hunger after receiving shelter.
changed_reading.after: Their careful procurement is the operational form of prepared mercy: refuge opens into provision through a tactful human intermediary.

context_deltas.mechanism: Before the delegate moves, concealment is maintained spatially by diverted exposure, a protected opening, and deterrent fear; the focus commands translate that fixed perimeter into portable behavior through fine movement and suppression of awareness.

activation_trace.role: Turning aside supplies an environmental deflection that prevents direct exposure.
The spacious interval supplies a protected interior where concealment can be maintained.
Fear supplies an active deterrent at the refuge's perceptual boundary.
Fine, nearly imperceptible movement makes the fixed shelter's concealment portable.
Fine awareness names the perceptual event the mobile perimeter must prevent.

structural_cues: 18:17-18 describe passive spatial and perceptual protection immediately before 18:19 requires active urban concealment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies environmental deflection, protected space, deterrent fear, fine movement, and blocked awareness; I infer that the delegate carries the refuge's boundary into the city as conduct, while an alternative treats the two protections as unrelated.

changed_reading.before: The cave hides them, and the delegate separately tries to be discreet.
changed_reading.after: Discretion is a portable refuge perimeter: the protection formerly performed by space must now be performed by the delegate's body and signaling.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following ayah supplies the consequence chain hidden inside the focus warning: discovery becomes dominance, dominance enables forced return to the surrounding creed, and that return produces permanent failure.

activation_trace.role: Outsider awareness is the first signal event that the security rule blocks.
Fine and hidden conduct is the preventive control placed before the threat chain.
Emergence into visibility supplies the discovery condition feared by the group.
Ascendancy and overpowering supply the hostile control that follows discovery.
An adhered-to creed supplies the social system into which they could be forcibly returned.
Winning and enduring supply the success that coerced return would negate.
Long duration and permanence extend the cost beyond immediate bodily danger.

structural_cues: 18:19 ends with non-disclosure; 18:20 begins with the conditional consequences if outsiders gain access to them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit discovery-to-coercion-to-permanent-failure sequence; I infer that the focus controls are designed against that sequence, while ordinary physical safety remains a live but narrower motive.

changed_reading.before: The delegate should avoid attracting dangerous attention.
changed_reading.after: Secrecy is anti-coercion security: it protects the group's capacity to remain outside a creed that discovery would allow hostile power to reimpose.

context_deltas.mechanism: The mirrored كذلك...لـ constructions stage opposite disclosures: they are awakened so they may question while trying to suppress all outsider awareness, then they are deliberately made discoverable so others may know a true promise.

activation_trace.role: Stirring from rest initiates the private knowledge event among the sleepers.
Fine awareness supplies the outsider cognition the group explicitly tries to prevent.
Causing access to what was hidden reverses the group's non-disclosure objective.
Disclosure to knowers supplies the public epistemic purpose of the later discovery.
A future-indicating sign supplies the proposition their discovery is made to verify.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the public conclusion produced from their exposure.

structural_cues: 18:19 opens وكذلك بعثناهم ليتساءلوا; 18:21 opens وكذلك أعثرنا عليهم ليعلموا.
The first causal frame produces private questioning and attempted concealment; the second produces public knowledge through discovery.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored causal syntax and opposed awareness outcomes; I infer a controlled temporal reversal in which human secrecy is valid locally but later repurposed by divine disclosure, while a live alternative reads the parallel as narrative transition without a concealment model.

changed_reading.before: Their objective is simply to remain undiscovered.
changed_reading.after: Their concealment is a valid but bounded phase: the same narrative design that protects private inquiry later reverses hiddenness into public evidence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's secondary س ل ل mapping rather than the conventional questioning branch. It remains anchored in the focus form at word 3 and gains local coherence from the later command to move finely and covertly. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for how inquiry extracts a usable thread from obscured memory, not as a replacement etymology.

activation_trace.role: Drawing something out gently and secretly supplies an exploratory image for eliciting memory from one another.
Fine hidden movement repeats the extraction image in the later practical mission.

changed_reading.before: They ask one another a direct question about elapsed time.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, reciprocal inquiry gently draws a surviving thread from inaccessible memory, then becomes a similarly low-signature extraction of provision from the city.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it scales a small internal exchange into a social-institutional contrast. It remains anchored by reciprocal questioning and the relational بين construction in 18:19, then by dispute and construction in 18:21. Downstream prose should qualify it as a contrast in information governance, not as a claim that the later building or mosque is itself condemned.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ليتساءلوا بينهم ... ولا يشعرن بكم أحدا

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal questioning supplies a live, distributed process for negotiating uncertainty.
The connection between participants supplies the private relational space in which no single estimate is forcibly fixed.
Mutual pulling between parties converts the later public meaning of the group into a contested object.
Joining material into a building supplies the mechanism by which a fluid dispute becomes a durable public form.
Prevailing force selects which public response is materialized.
A place of prostration supplies the institutional structure in which the prevailing response is fixed.

changed_reading.before: The sleepers privately discuss their condition and later outsiders debate what to build.
changed_reading.after: The focus preserves uncertainty through private reciprocal deliberation, whereas later public actors contest, prevail, and stabilize the group's meaning in architecture.

strongest_changes: The awakening becomes a measurement trial whose positive result is calibrated epistemic limitation rather than a correct human count.
The food errand becomes a screened provisioning chain and a concrete mediation of promised mercy.
Non-disclosure becomes anti-coercion security, then is deliberately reversed into public evidence by the mirrored 18:21 causal frame.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah compresses a complete transition from divine stirring, through distributed uncertainty and practical discrimination, to one-person low-signal action; nearby mirrored syntax then changes the same hidden group from protected subjects of inquiry into publicly disclosed evidence.
remaining_uncertainties: The link between the two أي-superlative constructions is structurally strong but does not prove that food selection carries the full evaluative weight of tested deeds.
The س ء ل to س ل ل extraction image is packet-resolvable but form-distant and should remain exploratory.
The later disclosure clearly limits concealment in time, but the packet alone does not settle how intentionally the sleepers' failed secrecy should be evaluated.
